purpose: Teach: 非合法/謀略/疎外/破裂/充満/退学/単発/創世

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、非合法な取引には関わるな
lines.en: Don't let this company get involved in anything illegal.
lines.style: Clipped, decisive opening. Each word lands with weight. No warmth—authority without performance. Shoulders steady, jaw set slightly forward.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。社内の謀略的な動きを早期に察知します
lines.en: Understood. I'll watch for any suspicious movements inside the organization early.
lines.style: Formal, respectful affirmation. Measured delivery, no rushing. Slight pause after the yes—absorbing the directive. Even tone, grounded stance.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、社員が疎外感を抱かない職場を作れ
lines.en: Build a workplace where our people don't feel left behind or isolated.
lines.style: Steady, deliberate instruction. Emphasis on 'our people'—this matters to him. Slight lean forward, eyes direct. No hurry. The weight of expectation carried lightly.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。工場のパイプの破裂事故を防ぐ点検を強化します
lines.en: Understood. I'll strengthen the safety inspections—especially to prevent any pipe failures at the factory.
lines.style: Quick, competent acknowledgment. Specific commitment follows without hesitation. Brisk pace, clear-headed. This is how you show you were listening.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、市場に流通商品を充満させろ
lines.en: Make sure our products reach the market in full supply.
lines.style: Direct, unsentimental order. Voice stays level but carries expectation. No softening. The kind of instruction that means 'this is non-negotiable.'

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。社員が退学した子を支える制度を作ります
lines.en: Understood. I'll create support systems for staff whose children have had to leave school.
lines.style: Calm, concrete response. Not performing compliance—living it. This is practical care hidden in bureaucratic language. Slight warmth underneath the formality.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、単発の成功で慢心するな
lines.en: Don't let a single win make this company careless or complacent.
lines.style: Firm wisdom delivered without lecturing. Slight pause before 'careless'—the real warning. Eyes steady. The voice of someone who has seen success breed blindness before.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。事業の創世期から学び続けます
lines.en: Understood. We'll keep learning from the roots of what we've built, from the beginning onwards.
lines.style: Quiet conclusion. Respectful, almost reflective. Not rushing the closing words. A promise made with steady breath. The acknowledgment of something larger than today's work.
